title: Opening A Conversation
label: ch:ml-address
canDo: I can call out to somebody I have never met, and I know which of my greetings to use with them.

payoff.summary: From cold: both calling words, the ending that makes one of them and why the other has nothing to change, and the rule for choosing among the five greetings already owned.
payoff.note: The chapter introduces exactly these four atoms and the payoff assesses all four. The register lesson teaches NO word: all five greetings were already taught, and what was missing was which of them a person actually says.
